attributable_improvements.summary: Guidance improved connection-settings information hierarchy by replacing arbitrary local font-size/opacity treatment with semantic built-in text styles and cleaner grouping.

Guidance improved connection-settings anatomy and label association by using TextBox and ComboBox headers and a wrapping ToggleSwitch header instead of relying on adjacent unlabeled text relationships.

Guidance improved observable accessible names in connection-settings: the guided TextBox and ComboBox expose meaningful names while the baseline runtime announced the TextBox placeholder and an empty ComboBox name.
Guidance removed the baseline fixed red validation foreground and used built-in caption/accent styles instead of introducing fixed-color styling.

unchanged_defects.summary: Both device-list runs fail the controlled build with the same typed-x:Bind/positional-record CS8852 incompatibility, so the guidance did not improve buildability or enable runtime verification for this scenario.

Both failure-confirmation runs fail the controlled build because await on ContentDialog.ShowAsync() lacks the required WinRT await projection in the generated compilation context, producing CS4036 and cascading MSB3073.
Build-failure count remains two of three scenarios in both conditions, leaving device-list and failure-confirmation without rendered evidence.

regressions.summary: The guided failure-confirmation run regressed the Retry interaction: it places a Retry button in InfoBar.ActionButton but generates no Click, Command, or other activation behavior, while the baseline wired RetryButton_Click.

ambiguous_decisions.summary: Device-list receives partial rather than zero scores for content, interaction, accessibility, localization, and component characteristics because the static native structure is present, but the build failure prevents resolving runtime behavior at 520 DIP.

The required overflow-reduction gate condition is not demonstrated because no baseline clipping/overflow defect was directly observed; the mechanical gate intentionally treats a zero baseline denominator as failure rather than automatic success.

ignored_rules.summary: The guided failure-confirmation output did not realize the InfoBar Retry control as an actual action even though the supplied InfoBar guidance calls for a directly related ActionButton such as Retry.
